facts: SockLock makes magnetic socks: a tiny magnet on the cuffs holds each pair together
Pairs stay together in the washer and dryer, so socks stop getting lost in the laundry
Subscription: 5 pairs for $29, then a new delivery every quarter
New customers take a short quiz and get a personal offer
audience: US adults who do the household laundry: busy parents, young professionals, people buying a practical gift
tone: Casual, self-aware, UGC-style: a real person filming on their phone. Short sentences, everyday words, light humor.

bannedPhrases.reason: Offer is $29 for 5 pairs, nothing is free
